content.short: XchangeOn is a cryptocurrency exchange platform offering Arbitrage, P2P, Spot, and Swap trading with an AI-powered cross-exchange arbitrage bot.
content.description: XchangeOn is a cryptocurrency exchange offering Spot, P2P, and Swap trading, built with an AI-powered cross-exchange arbitrage bot. Launched in 2021 by Omar Khan OK, it serves a global user base and is designed for both beginners and experienced traders, aiming for faster execution, stronger risk control, and straightforward onboarding with secure custody. The arbitrage engine monitors multiple markets in real time, identifies price gaps, and automatically executes eligible orders within user-defined limits.
